## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

Record the checks actually run and any remaining gaps.

## Documentation

Link the updated `docs/` pages (English and Korean), or explain why this change has
no documentation impact. Changes to behavior, defaults, API/settings, navigation,
constraints or commands require documentation in this same PR.

Contributors: record `pnpm docs:check`. Private renderer access is not required.
Maintainers: before merge, record the revision and `pnpm docs:build` result for
documentation changes; include preview/browser results for renderer or navigation changes.
